title: SR-71 pilot encourages Sherman to join the Air Force

tellings.quote: Um and of course the SR71 pilot he really encouraged me to go in the Air Force

plain: Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the NSA hired him to communicate with aliens, says that when he was young a pilot of the SR-71 spy plane strongly encouraged him to join the Air Force. He tells Michels this as part of his own life story, which also appears in a book called Above Black, and it is the first step on the path that he says led to that work.
